description: REQUIRES prior work24__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Enter the 대상자정보 step of an existing work24 subsidy draft and return its form contract. Requires a 접수번호 from workplace_save. Nothing is submitted. Some programmes save the draft between screens; safety.save_executed in the result says whether that happened. For an authenticated call, generate and save request_idempotency_key before the first request. Reuse it with the same arguments only to recover that request after a lost response; use a new key for a new execution. Without it, calling again remains a new request. This optional key is not available to anonymous taste calls. Keep any provider-specific idempotency_key unchanged; it is a different field. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

business_management_no.description: 11-digit 고용보험 사업장관리번호. 비우면 로그인 시 저장된 값을 쓴다.

programme_key.description: 카탈로그 사업 키 (예: w24_b0010 고용촉진장려금). subsidy_pack 진단 결과의 programme_key 를 그대로 넣는다.

request_idempotency_key.description: Optional same-request recovery key for authenticated calls; see the tool description.
